title: Voice experimental, both off by default: keyterms pilot (a listed site's own names to the speech service, bound to the account's seat) and approving a plan by voice behind the voice-plan-approval switch
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run the run.cmd below (node --test over the keyterm lookup, the relay with a stand-in speech service, the /ops Voice doors, the switch catalogue and the chat-input voice suites; no database, no speech key, no audio, nothing reaches ElevenLabs).
S2: Read the exit code and the pass/fail counts.
expect: Keyterms: no site listed by default (GET /api/ops/speech keyterms.sites = []); the relay asks the lookup only for a well-formed ?site=, the lookup answers nothing outside the pilot or without a live seat, and the terms reach only the stand-in service's handshake as repeated keyterms; the log line counts them ('[speech] keyterms: 2 sent, 2 echoed by the service') and holds no word.

cleanKeyterms keeps NFC, collapses spaces, dedupes case-insensitively keeping the first spelling and its marks, drops markup, addresses, generic labels and anything over 20 characters (never cut), at most 30.
voice-plan-approval is in the catalogue with defaultOn false; with it off, two plans, or a question card beside the plan, Voice says 'I have a plan for you to review on screen.' and goes to the chat.

With it on: the plan's title and scope are read; only a whole phrase approving it after the reading ended answers the card with Approve, once; 'Ừ', 'OK', 'Yes.', a longer sentence, Send now, a phrase begun as Tracy finished, or a changed plan never approve; 'Sửa kế hoạch …' answers Keep planning with the words as custom feedback.
Every translation of voiceMode.say.planAsk and voiceMode.bar.plan quotes an approval phrase isPlanApproval accepts and a change lead asksPlanChange accepts.

selectors.plan_by_voice: packages/ui/tracy-chat-input/src/client/voice-mode.mjs readPlan answerPlan; voice-turn-taking.mjs isPlanApproval asksPlanChange; voice-answer.mjs pendingPlan

evidence: Council 19/10/2026 (Codex gpt-6.1-sol, xhigh), ~/tracy-bench-work/voice-mode/council/a5-codex.md sections A1 and A6: the experimental half of the Voice backlog, each behind its own default-off setting.
fence: The keyterm lookup's pilot and seat gates, the relay's handshake address and log line, the /ops list door, and the plan approval conditions, through their own tests. Not exercised: the real ElevenLabs service (no STT quota spent), a real microphone, a live stand, dsh's real plan-review card.
